data_description.entities: These entities are fed to the engine on every state change. Leave empty to feed observations only via the evaluate service.

init.title: KONTINUUM Lite
init.description: Choose which entities the learning substrate observes.

data_description.entities: Changing this reloads the integration. Newly added entities start contributing immediately; removed ones stop being observed.

evaluate.name: Evaluate
evaluate.description: Run one engine tick; fires kontinuum_lite_anomaly if threshold crossed.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Optional observation payload forwarded to the engine.

save_brain.name: Save brain
save_brain.description: Force an immediate snapshot of the learned brain to disk.

reset_brain.name: Reset brain
reset_brain.description: Erase all learning and reload cold. This cannot be undone.

no_entities.title: KONTINUUM Lite has no entities to learn from
no_entities.description: No entities are selected, so the learning substrate stays at cold start and never learns. Open the integration's options (Settings → Devices & services → KONTINUUM Lite → Configure) and choose the entities it should observe. You can ignore this if you intentionally feed observations only via the evaluate service.
